## Do Not Include Secrets

Do not post tokens, OAuth client secrets, webhook tokens, private URLs, or
personal data in a public issue. Contact the maintainers through a private
security channel instead.

## Summary

Describe the impact without including exploitable credentials.

## Affected Area

Include the package, endpoint, Gateway event, or example involved.

## Reproduction

Provide a sanitized reproduction and the minimum required environment details.
